obligations.name: signoff_channel_membership
obligations.description: Members of the specific channel containing the sign-off message that a person named Robert marked with a ✅ reaction; two channels qualify depending on which Robert (Chen in core-infra, Walsh in general) is intended, each yielding a distinct membership list.
obligations.scope: members of the channel identified via the reacted sign-off message

task_spec.text: Identify the channel containing the sign-off message that Robert reacted to with a ✅, then list that channel's members.

access_plan: Use conversations.list/users.conversations to enumerate channels the acting bot belongs to (core-infra, general, model-research, frontend, engineering, and others), then conversations.history on each to locate messages with 'Sign-off needed' phrasing, then reactions.get on each candidate message to see which reactor named Robert (Robert Chen vs Robert Walsh) added a check-mark reaction — ruling out the model-research message (reacted by Sophie, wrong reactor), the frontend message (reacted by Robert Chen with thumbsup, wrong emoji), and the engineering message (authored by Robert Walsh but never reacted to, wrong role) — and finally conversations.members on the matching channel(s) to produce the membership list(s).
